passenger_root.description: The root directory where Passenger is installed. Usually detected automatically.

passenger_ruby.description: The Ruby interpreter path used by Passenger by default (for Ruby apps).

passenger_enabled.description: Enable Passenger globally (for all apps on this server).

passenger_min_instances.description: Minimum number of idle application instances to keep for each app.

passenger_max_instances.description: Maximum number of application instances across all apps. Controls memory/CPU usage.

passenger_max_preloader_idle_time.description: Maximum seconds a preloader may stay idle before shutting down (0 = unlimited).

passenger_pool_idle_time.description: Maximum seconds an application instance may remain idle before being shut down.

passenger_status_display.description: Enable the built-in Passenger status page (e.g., for monitoring).

passenger_max_requests.description: Maximum requests per instance before it restarts. Set to 0 to disable.

passenger_buffer_response.description: Buffer app responses to clients. Helps with slow clients but increases memory use.

startup_file.description: Optional custom startup file for the main app (e.g., 'config.ru' or 'app.py').

env_vars.description: Global environment variables passed to all Passenger-managed applications.

apps.description: List of applications to host with Passenger.

base_uri.description: URL path prefix for this app (e.g., '/' or '/api')

document_root.description: Path to app's public/ or root directory

interpreter.description: Custom interpreter path for this app (e.g., /opt/ruby-3.0/bin/ruby)

environment.description: App runtime environment (e.g., development, staging, production)

min_instances.description: Override global min_instances for this app

max_instances.description: Override global max_instances for this app

buffer_response.description: Override global buffer_response for this app
